properties.description: Remnant of the Labrador ice dome c. 6950 cal BP (map 5000, item 5000bc-6), APPROXIMATE: the Labrador part of m6-laurentide shrunk about its centre to c. 250,000 km2 - the difference of ice areas between the 6 ka 14C (c. 6.8 cal ka) and 5 ka 14C isochrones in Dalton et al. 2020, table 1 (2.45 vs 2.19 million km2: 'reduction of Labrador Dome'). The whole Laurentide ice was gone by 6.7 +- 0.4 ka (Ullman et al. 2016). To be redrawn from the shapefiles (Dyke et al. 2003, GSC OF 1574, or NADI-1, Zenodo 8161764) at the 'sea inland' stage (item 5000bc-4).
